news.headline: Should You Buy Wolfspeed Stock Right Now?
news.description: Wolfspeed emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy by reducing debt by 70% and replacing existing stock with new shares, resulting in shareholders receiving only one new share for every 120 previously owned.

news.headline: Why Is Wolfspeed Stock Plummeting Today?
news.description: Wolfspeed exited Chapter 11 bankruptcy by canceling existing shares and issuing new stock, severely diluting shareholders with only one new share for every 120 old shares, causing the stock price to drop significantly.
